abortPolicy.emailSearch: When looking for a key-delivery message, search only for the expected sender/subject pattern. Never widen the search to other messages.
abortPolicy.keyMaterial: A key is never typed into chat, never written to a log, never sent to any CivicScope server, and never read back by the agent as proof. The only accepted proof of setup is the app's own re-validation event for that key.
abortPolicy.unexpectedScreen: Halt before any key entry, report key state by presence only (never key material), and hand off to the manual path at the step equivalent to the step where the halt happened.

census.label: Census API key
census.manualPath: Manual path: the setup wizard's 'Your keys' step (open the signup form, paste the emailed key; the app validates before saving)

meta.label: Meta Model API key (personal, optional)
meta.manualPath: Manual path: the setup wizard's 'Your keys' step (paste the key; the app validates with its own call before storing)

purpose: An AI agent walks a fresh user through obtaining and placing the two browser-held keys this app can use — the free Census API key and an optional personal Meta Model API key — without the key material ever appearing in agent output or logs or being accepted as an agent report. Setup success is confirmed only by the app's own re-validation events, named per key below.
